text:
[CONSENT ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Consent Items 1 - 18]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of the First Amendment to Contract DA-5693 with Global Resource Management Inc. dba GRM Research: To extend the three (3)-year term by five (5) months and increase the contract authority by $198,000, for new total not to exceed $642,520, covering guest satisfaction survey field data collection services at Los Angeles International Airport (Jackie Grass)
summary: Extension and increase of guest satisfaction survey contract with GRM Research at Los Angeles International Airport, with additional $198,000 funding for total of $642,520.
